'''John A. Ricketts''' (February 29, 1924 – June 29, 2007)<ref name="obit">{{Cite news|date=2007-07-02|title=John A. Ricketts (Obituary)|url=https://www.bannergraphic.com/story/1220923.html|access-date=2021-09-11|newspaper=Greencastle Banner Graphic|language=en}}</ref> was an American chemist, chemistry educator and academic. He was a former Simeon Smith Professor of Chemistry at [[DePauw University]].<ref name="obit" /><ref>{{Cite web|title=Prof. John Ricketts Awarded NSF Research Fellowship|url=https://www.depauw.edu/news-media/latest-news/details/19580/|access-date=2021-09-11|website=DePauw University|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Happy "10th" Birthday, Prof. John Ricketts!|url=https://www.depauw.edu/news-media/latest-news/details/19666/|access-date=2021-09-11|website=DePauw University|date=February 29, 1964|language=en|archive-date=2021-09-11|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210911024816/https://www.depauw.edu/news-media/latest-news/details/19666/|url-status=dead}}</ref>
He was lecturer in chemistry at [[Fenn College]] (which later became Cleveland State University) in Cleveland, Ohio. before joining DePauw.
He was director of graduate studies at DePauw from 1966 until 1970.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Prof. John Ricketts Appointed DePauw's Director of Graduate Studies|url=https://www.depauw.edu/news-media/latest-news/details/19664/|date=June 20, 1966|access-date=2021-09-11|website=DePauw University|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=DePauw Mourns the Passing of Prof. Emeritus John Ricketts|url=https://www.depauw.edu/news-media/latest-news/details/19662/|date=June 29, 2007|access-date=2021-09-11|website=DePauw University|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Prof. John Ricketts Awarded NSF Research Fellowship|url=https://www.depauw.edu/news-media/latest-news/details/19580/|access-date=2021-09-11|website=DePauw University|date=April 23, 1957|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Ricketts|first1=John A.|last2=Bowen|first2=Ronald E.|date=September 1960 |title=Acid-base titrations with the tellurium electrode|url=https://pubs.acs.org/doi/pdf/10.1021/ed037p473|journal=Journal of Chemical Education|volume=37|issue=9|pages=473|doi=10.1021/ed037p473|bibcode=1960JChEd..37..473R|issn=0021-9584|url-access=subscription}}</ref>
